evidence: Workbook Quality Checks row 12: "[environment].docker_image isn't set while the agent Dockerfile still has active build steps (which would skip the Dockerfile entirely)." Skill quality-checks.md check 12 and staged-task-contract.md:78 say the same ("`[environment].docker_image` must be absent while the Dockerfile has active build steps"). Frozen task/task.toml:20-24 has the whole [environment] table as `build_timeout_sec = 600.0`, `network_mode = "public"`, `cpus = 2`, `memory_mb = 4096`; there is no docker_image key there, and [verifier.environment] (line 37-38) holds only `network_mode = "public"`. A case-insensitive search for `docker_image` over the whole frozen task tree (toml, sh, md, Dockerfile) returns no match. task/environment/Dockerfile has active build steps (FROM node:22-bookworm-slim, two RUN installs at lines 5-12, COPY instructions/ and assets/ at 14-15, RUN chmod + git init at 16-23), so those steps are what builds the agent image. Both task.toml's [environment] table and environment/Dockerfile are byte-for-byte the same content as the frozen template's files. No compose file or other image override ships in the task. This is a static configuration check that is fully decided by the source; no runtime measurement is required for it. Evidence-index note: run_golden.sh hash verified (a94328b9...d37a), but that script runs a pre-built local image passed in as $app_image rather than exercising Harbor's image resolution, and the hosted run was on an earlier candidate, so neither is cited as a measurement of this row.
